usage: The word 運動衫 refers to clothes specifically designed for physical exercise or sports activities.
運動衫 is a countable noun, so you can say '一件運動衫' (one sportswear item).
You can use 運動衫 both in singular and plural contexts without changing form.
It can be combined with adjectives to describe the type of sportswear, like 新運動衫 (new sportswear) or 舒服嘅運動衫 (comfortable sportswear).
運動衫 can be used generally for all sportswear or more specifically for tops like t-shirts or jerseys used during workouts.
